page_title: ARS 5-1 MCI | Arsenal v Manchester City 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' 5 - 1 Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) meets a perfect cross from Declan Rice on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike straight into the left side of the goal. It's 5:1.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Kai Havertz is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Raheem Sterling (Arsenal).
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) replaces Myles Lewis-Skelly.
90' The attendance for today's match is 60355.
89' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) is about to take a corner kick.
89' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
84' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Martin Odegaard and he is replaced by Mikel Merino (Arsenal).
84' Substitution. Leandro Trossard makes his way off the pitch and Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.

83' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Peter Bankes saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Arsenal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
82' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
81' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
80' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
76' 4 - 1 Goal Kai Havertz (Arsenal)! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) was put through by Gabriel Martinelli and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 4:1.
74' It looks like Erling Haaland (Manchester City) saw red with that tackle. Peter Bankes won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Arsenal have a free kick.
73' The corner from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is intercepted by Stefan Ortega.
72' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) replacing Omar Marmoush.
72' James McAtee (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Phil Foden.
71' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was probably a bit loose with his words to Peter Bankes, who decides to show him a yellow.
71' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) brings an opponent down and Peter Bankes interrupts the game. Manchester City have a free kick.
70' Declan Rice (Arsenal) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
69' Manchester City concede a free kick following a bad challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Arsenal.
68' Great save! Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Stefan Ortega.
65' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
62' 3 - 1 Goal! Declan Rice tees up Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the right side of the goal. 3:1.
62' Savinho (Manchester City) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
60' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
59' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
56' 2 - 1 GOAL! Thomas Partey (Arsenal) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 2:1.

55' 1 - 1 Savinho sends a superb cross into the box. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the roof of the net, leaving David Raya beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
54' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

52' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
51' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
51' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick.
49' Manchester City are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Savinho (Manchester City) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the bottom left corner, but David Raya reacts superbly to deny him.
42' Phil Foden (Manchester City) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal are awarded the free kick.
42' A pass by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' Savinho (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

40' Manchester City are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
37' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
34' Dangerous play by Manuel Akanji (Manchester City). Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal have been awarded a free kick.
34' A lofted cross from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
33' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) will take a corner kick.
32' Phil Foden (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Manchester City have a corner.

32' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Peter Bankes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Manchester City will take a free kick near the side line.
30' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
28' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

27' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
26' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
25' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Peter Bankes didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
25' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Arsenal get a free kick.
25' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
24' A player from Arsenal pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Manchester City will take a free kick.
24' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
23' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) prepares to take a corner kick.

23' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
22' Phil Foden (Manchester City) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
19' The Manchester City players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

18' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
17' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Stefan Ortega comes off the line to clear the ball away.
13' Savinho (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
10' A player from Arsenal takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City are awarded a free kick.
10' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is flagged for offside.
9' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is caught offside!
8' Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
6' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
5' Arsenal are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Kai Havertz tees up Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the middle of the goal. 1:0.
1' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Stefan Ortega easily deals with the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes is the one to supervise the game today.
